extraction.notes: Three months ended Dec 31, 2022 column only. Starting line is net income attributable to common stockholders ($43,425). The Series E preferred distributions ($1,105) sit between FFO basic and FFO diluted; I placed them in ffo_adjustments so ffo_total is the printed diluted FFO ($196,706), which reproduces the diluted per-share figure. Basic FFO ($195,601) is the subtotal after the real estate items. Zero-valued dash lines (JV gain on sale, debt extinguishment, DCP variable upside, legal, JV casualty) are included as 0 because they are printed as '-'. Checks: 196,706/350,372 = 0.56; 213,193/350,372 = 0.61; 186,082/350,372 = 0.53. AFFO deducts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Figures are in thousands and the share count is printed in thousands.
